items.title: Welcome to my corner of the internet
items.excerpt: Why I made this space — a home for my architecture, research, travels and everything in between.
items.body:
Namaste, and welcome!

This website is my personal space on the internet — somewhere between a studio, a notebook and a photo album. Here you will find my architecture and urban design work, the research I am slowly chipping away at, and the travels, events and small moments that shape how I see cities and spaces.

## Why a journal?

Architecture school taught me to present finished work — clean boards, final renders. But most of what I love happens in between: the field visits, the sketches that go nowhere, the conversations on-site, the streets that surprise you. This journal is for those in-between things.

Expect travel notes, reflections from the USYC 2026 cohort, research updates, photo stories and the occasional unfiltered thought about Kathmandu's streets.

Thanks for stopping by — and do say hello through the connect page!
